verdict.rationale: Honeycomb is shown only as a hosted SaaS. Nothing in the evidence documents a local, self-hosted, or emulated instance of the platform for testing instrumentation and dashboards. The free plan, the interactive demo, and API management of 'environments' are related features (pricing tier, shared demo, SaaS account partitioning), not a spin-up-able dev instance of the platform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
